facet.description: Which facet is overridden. A CLOSED set: an unrecognised name ("effect class") used to be discarded in silence while its justification stayed in the record, so the package read as the opposite of what was derived.

conditions.description: The prose conditions the published guardrail predicates ask about THIS step — 'step invokes any registered tool', 'the source is spoofable'. Answer every one: an unanswered condition is refused, never read as false, because a guardrail that silently fails to fire is invisible.

sensitivity.description: How sensitive the data this step READS is. G21 is predicated on it; with no value it defaults to `internal`, and a step handling restricted data then carries no outbound control.

trust.description: How trustworthy that input is. Defaults to `authoritative`, which is the assumption a grounding control exists to question.

freshness.description: How current it must be. G17 is predicated on it; defaults to `static`.

determines_externally.description: The exposure class of an effect this step determines OUTSIDE this workflow — a number the graph cannot know, which is why this one IS asked. Null when the step determines nothing beyond the steps the graph already records.
